title: Soong Modules, Products, Flags, and APEX Boundaries Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies soong modules, products, flags, and apex boundaries?
options: Model explicit typed modules, dependencies, visibility, product selection, partition or APEX availability, and deterministic outputs.
questions.answer: Model explicit typed modules, dependencies, visibility, product selection, partition or APEX availability, and deterministic outputs.
questions.explanation: The correct response preserves authority, compatibility, exact artifact evidence, adverse-path behavior, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Every module declared in Android.bp is installed automatically into all AOSP product images.
questions.explanation: Adding a module to Android.bp compiles it only when selected by the graph; it does not automatically install it in every product image.

questions.prompt: What decides whether a built module is present on a product?
questions.answer: Product and dependency selection plus install and partition properties, not merely the existence of its Android.bp declaration.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the contract or mechanism that remains valid beyond one implementation demonstration.
